chapters.title: The talent shortage in the Business Central ecosystem
Need for digital natives and new perspectives
Reskill program addressing the talent gap
Value of combined recruiting, training and mentoring

features.name: Reskill program
features.description: A program that combines recruiting, training, onboarding and mentoring of candidates to help fill the talent gap in the Business Central ecosystem. Helps partners find and develop qualified staff more efficiently than doing it independently.
